scheme_name: Scheme to Provide Financial Assistance to the Publishers for Publishing Books of Goan Authors
description:
The Scheme to Provide Financial Assistance to the Publishers for Publishing Books of Goan Authors was launched by the Government of Goa in the year 2021.

This initiative aims to promote literature and support local authors in Goa by providing financial assistance to publishers.

The scheme is particularly significant as it seeks to enhance the visibility of Goan literature and encourage the publication of works by local authors.

The primary objective of the scheme is to provide financial support to publishers who are willing to publish books authored by Goan writers.

The government has set a target to support the publication of at least 50 books annually under this scheme.

The assistance provided is aimed at covering a substantial portion of the publishing costs incurred by the publishers.

The financial assistance amount is fixed at ₹1 lakh per book published.

This amount is intended to help cover expenses such as editing, design, printing, and marketing of the books.

The scheme specifically targets books that are written in any language recognized in Goa including Konkani, Marathi, Hindi, and English.

Eligibility for this scheme is limited to publishers who are registered and have a valid registration under the Companies Act or the Partnership Act.

Publishers must also have a track record of publishing books for at least three years.

In addition to publishers, the authors must be residents of Goa and must have a valid proof of residence.

The authors should also have a minimum of one previously published book to qualify for this assistance.

The application process for this scheme involves several steps.

First, publishers must submit an application form which can be obtained from the Directorate of Art and Culture, Government of Goa.

The application form must be accompanied by a detailed project proposal outlining the book to be published.

Publishers are required to provide a copy of the author’s previous work as proof of their writing credentials.

Additionally, a copy of the publisher's registration certificate must be included in the application.

Once the application is submitted, it will be reviewed by a committee constituted by the Directorate of Art and Culture.

The committee will evaluate the proposals based on the literary merit of the work and the credentials of the author.

If approved, the financial assistance will be disbursed in two installments.

The first installment of 50 percent will be released upon approval of the application.

The second installment will be released after the book is published and a copy is submitted to the Directorate.

The scheme is expected to run on a continuous basis with no specific end date mentioned.

Publishers can apply for assistance at any time during the year.

The Directorate of Art and Culture is the implementing authority for this scheme.

They are responsible for overseeing the application process and disbursing the funds.

For any inquiries regarding the scheme, publishers can contact the Directorate of Art and Culture at their office located in Patto, Panaji, Goa.

The contact number for the Directorate is +91 832 243 7006.

The scheme also aims to foster a culture of reading and writing in Goa.

By supporting local authors, the government hopes to create a vibrant literary community.

The initiative is part of a broader strategy to promote cultural heritage and local talent in Goa.

The government has allocated a budget of ₹5 crore for this scheme for the financial year 2021-2022.

This budget is expected to cover the financial assistance for publishing at least 50 books.

The scheme is also expected to boost the local economy by supporting the publishing industry in Goa.

It encourages collaboration between authors and publishers, fostering a supportive ecosystem for literature.

The financial assistance is not only limited to the publication of new works but also includes reprints of previously published books.

This aspect of the scheme is particularly important for authors whose works have been out of print.

The scheme also emphasizes the importance of promoting regional languages and literature.

By providing assistance for books in Konkani and other local languages, the government aims to preserve and promote Goa's linguistic heritage.

The scheme has received positive feedback from the literary community in Goa.

Many authors have expressed gratitude for the support provided by the government.

The initiative is seen as a significant step towards recognizing the contributions of Goan authors to the literary world.

The government has also planned workshops and seminars to further promote the scheme and educate potential applicants about the process.

These workshops will be conducted in various locations across Goa to reach a wider audience.

The scheme is expected to enhance the quality of literature produced in Goa.

By providing financial support, the government aims to reduce the financial burden on publishers.

This will enable them to take risks on new authors and innovative works.

The scheme also aligns with the government's vision of promoting education and literacy in the state.

It is part of a larger effort to enhance the cultural landscape of Goa.

The government encourages both established and emerging authors to take advantage of this scheme.

Overall, the Scheme to Provide Financial Assistance to the Publishers for Publishing Books of Goan Authors represents a significant investment in the future of Goan literature.

It reflects the government's commitment to supporting local talent and fostering a rich literary culture in the state.
